create_transaction.description: Transfer in-game money from your own application account to another application of the same project. The amount is checked against the account balance and the project transfer rules, which may change the credited amount or forbid the transfer.

params.to_project_application_id[0]: ID of the recipient application (in-game account number)
params.from_bank_currency_id[0]: ID of the in-game currency debited from your account
params.bank_currency_id[0]: ID of the in-game currency credited to the recipient

qrpg_hacking_start.description: Start hacking a QR code: marks the attempt as started and returns the mini-game board (matrix, target sequences) and the time limit. Has no effect on an already started attempt.

params.qha_id: ID of the registered hacking attempt

qrpg_bank_pay.description: Make an in-game payment against a scanned banking QR code: debits the amount from your application account and credits it to the recipient.

params.account_num_to: In-game account number of the recipient (their application ID)
params.bank_currency_id: ID of the in-game payment currency
params.name: Purpose of the payment

prepare_q_rpg_bank_code.description: Build a banking QR code requesting a payment to yourself: another player scans it and confirms the transfer. Debits and credits nothing on its own.

params.bank_currency_id: ID of the in-game currency the payment is requested in
params.name: Purpose of the payment

set_geoposition.description: Record the player's current geoposition for their active application. Every call appends a new point to the movement history.

qrpg_get_keys_and_properties.description: Get the in-game keys and properties available through the current user's active application. Changes nothing.

qrpg_decode.description: Process a scanned project QR code: hand out the keys, properties or payment bound to it, or continue a started hacking attempt or access-code entry. Writes the result into the QRPG usage history.

params.data: QR code content as a JSON string: p — project ID, c — code ID, h — checksum, r, cu, a, n — recipient application, currency, amount and purpose for banking codes
params.hacking_sequence: Sequence entered while hacking, as a JSON string
params.qha_id: ID of the hacking attempt, if the code is opened by hacking
params.text_to_access: Entered access code, if the code is opened by typing text
params.qhi_id: ID of the QRPG usage history record the entered access code belongs to
